preconditions.description: The number of towns n must be between 3 and 100,000.
The number of monasteries m must be at least 2 and less than the number of towns n.

preconditions.expression: len(monasteries) == m and all(1 <= town <= n for town in monasteries)
preconditions.description: The list of monastery towns must contain exactly m distinct integers, each between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b and 1 <= c <= 1000 for a, b, c in edges)
preconditions.description: There must be exactly n-1 edges, each connecting two distinct towns with a valid length.

postconditions.description: The output must consist of two integers: the maximum number of unhappy pilgrims and the number of ways to achieve this.
The maximum number of unhappy pilgrims must be non-negative.
The number of ways to make the maximum number of pilgrims unhappy must be at least 1.
